summary: Overview of built-in documents search in forge
Preconditions: works without doc-link or doc-db backends
FNC-001: query-forge-rules entry point returning a Required documents list of plugins/forge paths
Empty list instead of an error when nothing matches
FNC-002: semantic selection that includes doubtful documents and avoids omissions
FNC-003: search only, no writes, commits or Issue updates, and imperative inputs treated as search tasks
Out of scope: project rule and spec document search
Error cases: missing index or incomplete search reported with no list returned
tasks: Writing or reviewing tests for the search behavior
Calling the search from other forge skills
Defining error handling for missing index or failed search
Reviewing requirements for built-in docs search
